assets: Use case: scientific-educational. A sober photoreal imagined reconstruction of the legendary Atlantis, for an occult research documentary. Wide 16:9 view underwater: monumental ancient stone columns, submerged avenues and broken circular civic structures under deep blue water, sunbeams filtering from the surface, realistic marine particles, archaeology expedition atmosphere, no people or creatures, no modern machinery. Majestic but restrained, credible natural textures, not a game screenshot. No text or logo. The image is a hypothetical reconstruction, not evidence of a real archaeological discovery.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Wide 16:9 cinematic documentary illustration evoking a highly secretive remote military aircraft testing base in the Nevada desert, viewed from outside a chain link fence at late dusk. Distant low aircraft hangars, runway lights, dry lakebed, mountain silhouette, locked gate, deep muted colors, fine realistic textures, austere mysterious atmosphere. No UFOs, no aliens, no people, no readable writing or logos. This is a generic illustrative reconstruction for discussing Area 51 legends, not a photograph of the actual installation.
